question: 7 boys A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B is not the immediate neighbour of X. C is fifth to the left of D. C is the immediate neighbour of B and Y. A is the immediate neighbour of Z and D. Who is sitting fourth to the left of B?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given: A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre

C is fifth to the left of D

C is the immediate neighbour of B and Y

A is the immediate neighbour of Z and D

B is not the immediate neighbour of X

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14d58eaf201ac4f083f4e95f34f4180b06dd0aaca134e734c53499730eaa2fbb.png] 

 

Now, fourth to the left of B = X

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
